question: BlueQuill Systems, a design automation startup, wants to add generative AI to tools used by eight internal teams and is comparing Amazon Q for automating enterprise workflows with Amazon Bedrock for working with foundation models; which statements correctly explain their key differences in capabilities, model choice, and typical use so the team can assign the right service to each workload? (Choose 2)
correctanswer: B. Amazon Q is a generative AI assistant for ready-to-use business and developer workflows, while Amazon Bedrock is a managed platform to build and scale generative AI solutions with foundation models
D. Amazon Bedrock offers a catalog of foundation models to choose from, but Amazon Q does not let you select the underlying model
incorrectansweroption2: A. Amazon Q allows you to pick from multiple foundation models, whereas Amazon Bedrock restricts you to a single default model
incorrectansweroption3: C. Both Amazon Q and Amazon Bedrock are assistants that ship as prepackaged generative AI apps

question: An academic consortium is building a climate forecasting model using Amazon SageMaker and wants other scientists to verify how the model makes decisions. correctanswer: C. The source code can be examined and adapted, making behavior easier to understand

incorrectansweroption3: B. Open-source licensing always permits unrestricted commercial use

question: Meridian Finance operates an AI-powered HR analytics platform on AWS that processes confidential employee records. question: A parcel delivery network at MetroShip uses Amazon Bedrock to forecast late arrivals from traffic feeds. question: A retail marketplace named RiverCart is moving to AWS and plans to power personalized product suggestions with Amazon Bedrock. question: At a cybersecurity startup using Amazon SageMaker to classify unsolicited email collected over the last 120 days, you need to compare models by how well they distinguish spam from legitimate messages regardless of where the prediction threshold is set. Which evaluation method should you use to understand performance across all possible decision cutoffs?
correctanswer: C. AUC-ROC to evaluate threshold-independent separability
incorrectansweroption2: A. Average precision on the precision–recall curve
incorrectansweroption3: B. Confusion matrix at a chosen score cutoff
incorrectansweroption4: D. F1 score computed at a single operating point

question: A streaming startup called AuroraPlay wants to add machine learning so that when a viewer selects a title, the app shows closely related content to boost discovery and engagement. Which option describes a capability that Amazon Personalize can provide?
correctanswer: C. Recommend items that are most similar to a product a user is viewing

question: A logistics company is using Amazon SageMaker to train a vision model with 90,000 labeled warehouse photos to detect damaged parcels across different lighting conditions and camera angles. The team wants the model to generalize to new images and avoid both overfitting and underfitting. Which statements correctly differentiate overfitting from underfitting? (Choose 2)
correctanswer: B. Simplifying the model can reduce overfitting, while adding more labeled training data can lessen underfitting
E. Overfitting occurs when a model performs well on training data but poorly on new data, while underfitting fails to capture patterns even in the training data
incorrectansweroption2: A. More complex models invariably outperform simpler ones
incorrectansweroption3: C. Underfitting shows strong training accuracy but weak validation accuracy, while overfitting performs poorly on both

question: A digital media company is fine-tuning a foundation model in Amazon Bedrock to study audience interactions and anticipate content demand. Which storage service should the team choose?
correctanswer: B. Amazon S3
incorrectansweroption2: A. Amazon RDS

question: ByteCraft Electronics operates a customer help portal where shoppers ask about device compatibility and warranty terms. The team needs Amazon Q Business to return precise answers that reflect catalog and policy changes that sync every 45 minutes from internal systems. correctanswer: B. Uses Retrieval Augmented Generation to pull the latest catalog and policy content and ground the answer in that context
incorrectansweroption2: A. Generates responses only from the model’s general training data without checking company-specific sources
incorrectansweroption3: C. Delivers replies from a static, rule-driven knowledge base that is not updated in real time
incorrectansweroption4: D. Enforces guardrails and content filters to block unsafe topics instead of retrieving fresh business data

question: A sports arena in Chicago operates gated parking with IP cameras at each entrance. Which AWS service should they use to implement this solution?
correctanswer: B. Amazon Rekognition

question: A drone logistics startup is building an AI flight controller to improve obstacle avoidance and route selection for autonomous quadcopters. The team will use deep learning and wants to clearly understand how a neural network learns from large volumes of flight and video data so it can make split-second choices. correctanswer: C. Training in deep learning iteratively updates network weights and biases using backpropagation with optimizers like gradient descent on large datasets to minimize a loss function

question: Northstar Analytics is building an internal assistant with an Amazon Bedrock foundation model and wants to lower monthly token spend while keeping answer quality high. Which approach is the most effective to achieve this?
